question: Can the saved trial-discoverability corpus support a reproducible independently checkable diagnosis/cohort reference set for a useful ranking or review-effort benchmark?
purpose: First concrete repair step, not another no-go audit. Build labels and expose uncertainty before ranking. Current parent-search containment does not defeat workload benefit.
frame: Frozen6182-query-union records; current interventional strata and historical challenge cases must remain separate. This is not an exhaustive eligibility denominator. Define diagnosis-trial/cohort labels, not patient eligibility.
selection: Before reading eligibility or existing worker labels, freeze deterministic selection from saved query membership/status/type only: EMC/DSRCT/SS; per diagnosis up to4 ordinary-retrieved,4 molecular-only versus strong ordinary,4 parent-only versus both (seed20260905). Preserve empty/small strata without replacement from other strata. Include6 separately named historical/challenge anchors (NCT05918640,NCT05071209,NCT06571734,NCT05135975,NCT05687136,NCT06094101), with appropriate diagnosis-pair definition frozen before reading. Anchors are challenge cases, not probability-sample additions.
labels: Read full inclusion/exclusion/cohort text for selected pairs; label explicit diagnosis compatibility, defining-fusion/class compatibility, broad-solid-tumor compatibility, explicit exclusion, extra-biomarker/protocol uncertainty, or insufficient evidence. Preserve cohort and recruitment uncertainty separately. Every judgment cites exact raw JSON pointer and concise rationale. Do not infer patient eligibility or label unjudged records negative. Build label protocol and reference pack before any ranking evaluation.
independence: Do not read previous evidence.json/curate.py labels before independently labeling. Disclose prior task-prompt knowledge/known anchors; no false blinding claim. Coordinator separately verifies a bounded label pack. No inter-rater claim from one worker.
validation: Verify deterministic selection/time/hash, raw pointers, all selected cases accounted for, explicit unresolved labels. Offline script regenerates selection and evidence pointers. Assess whether positive/control diversity is informative for a next benchmark; if too sparse propose a precise sampling/enumeration repair rather than declaring the paper impossible.
next_if_success: Fresh ranking round with competent ordinary/hierarchy baselines and molecular augmentation on fixed labels; report precision/workload only at honestly bounded scope and matched information.
stop: One medium fresh worker,own bounded goal,1800scientificseconds,no nested tasks/runners. No original manuscripts/preregistration/registry edits or publication. No paid API/GPU. Freeze useful partial labels at deadline; checkpoint rather than force complete-paper decision.
